messages:
Priya (Contractor): Hey everyone — starting tomorrow. Quick policy question: my client contract forbids installing third-party management on any client-facing laptops. I was offered a company image but it's delayed in shipping. Can I skip enrolling my personal Mac and instead use a hosted dev box? Also, are contractors automatically part of the new-hire phishing sims? Don't want to violate client rules.
People Ops: Welcome Priya! :wave: Contractors are normally on the same security program as employees, but we make accommodations. Please submit the access request form and attach the contract clause. Security can approve a temporary exemption or provision a hardened guest VM/cloud workstation.
Marta (IT): Hi @Priya — technical details: if you can't enroll a personal device we can provide a managed guest VM (redwood-guest-2026) or a cloud dev instance with our monitoring agents preinstalled. Neither option will get production KMS keys. If you want faster access, DM your shipping address and we can prioritize laptop shipping.
Priya (Contractor): Thanks Marta. If I take the guest VM, will I still be enrolled in the phishing simulation? My client explicitly prohibits interacting with external links/emails during the contract term.
Evan (Security): Good flag. Phish simulations are targeted by org unit and role. Contractors running in our guest VM are normally included because we need to validate behavior. However, we can approve a temporary sim exemption if you supply the relevant contract clause documenting the restriction. We need the justification in writing and the exemption will be time-limited to the contract term. Please attach it to your access request and tag me.
phish-sim-bot: New-joiner phishing simulation window: 2026-04-12 -> 2026-04-14 UTC. Exemption requests must be submitted by 2026-04-10. (automated message)
Priya (Contractor): Got it. I'll submit the access request now and attach the contract PDF. One more thing — how can I confirm MDM enrollment or check for the profile if I end up enrolling the company laptop when it arrives?
Marta (IT): On macOS, open System Settings -> Profiles or run `sudo profiles status -type enrollment`. If enrolled you'll see the Redwood MDM profile and the management certificate. If a manual install fails, paste the output of `profiles -I -F ~/Downloads/redwood_mdm.mobileconfig` here and we'll triage.
Priya (Contractor): Thanks! Submitting form and tagging Evan for the exemption. Appreciate the quick answers.
People Ops: Great — ping this thread after you submit and we'll escalate so IT/security can prioritize. :rocket:
